ownRead.title: Scale, lifetime and possibility-space growth
ownRead.description: An open claim retained by the selected v0.2.1 companion.
ownRead.researchEdition: RRG v0.3.1 — relation to existing work, 2026-10-07
ownRead.statement: **O3 — Scale, lifetime and possibility-space growth.** Later levels may often be larger, slower or capable of different organization. Whether any measure grows monotonically is unproved. Levels can coexist; an implementation may stop, branch, shrink or lose stability. New effective coordinates do not automatically add fundamental microscopic dimensions.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

Begin by specifying what grows: persistence, diversity, number of connected stages or another model quantity. The companion allows stopping, branching, coexistence and disruption; one size measure is not a universal complexity measure. A contribution could compare those outcomes under a stated model and regime, without assuming monotonic progress.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
